## Outcome

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue with `Refs #N`; use a closing reference only when merging meets every scoped acceptance criterion.

## Verification

Record relevant checks and results. Distinguish local implementation, deployed behavior, hardware readback and measured field outcomes. Link durable evidence and state remaining limits.

## Handoff

Identify remaining acceptance checks, follow-up issues and any separately required deployment or hardware authorization. Keep credentials and identifiable operational data private.
